reasoning: On the season so far the Raptors are the stronger team; with home court the 76ers start about 2 points better, in a game of about 223 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the 76ers.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the 76ers win 72 times in 100, by about 5; most games like this end between 197 and 245 total points.

analyst.text: Toronto arrive on the second night of a back-to-back after blowing a 22-point home lead in a 98-93 loss to Boston. They are still without Scottie Barnes and Kawhi Leonard and have used six starting lineups in ten games. Philadelphia are coming off a 22-point home loss to the Celtics, but both LeBron James (back) and Joel Embiid (foot) are questionable, with the Sixers openly managing their workloads before Indiana and Brooklyn. A deflating collapse plus fatigue leans the mood toward Philadelphia, as long as their stars play.
